headline: Approved previous meeting minutes and discussed Veterans Day service plans, including speaker, music, flags, and seating.
summary: Members continued planning the Veterans Day service. George Messier said Joe Pager, a Vietnam era Veteran, will be the speaker. The secretary will work on the minister and National Anthem, and members discussed flags, seats for holders, and Gold Star banners.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the previous meeting as submitted.

decision_evidence.quote: Minutes for previous meeting approved as submitted.

plain_text:
VETERAN’S MEMORIAL COMMITTEE 
 
Meeting of the Veterans Memorial Committee was held on October 5, 2026 at Wallingford Town Hall 
Room 220. Chairman Ruth Palmer called the meeting to order at 1900. There were 9 members present.  
 
Minutes for previous meeting approved as submitted. 
 
This meeting is to continue planning Veterans Day service. 
 
George Messier said that speaker will be Joe Pager, a Vietnam era Veteran. George has invited him to a 
meeting. 
 
Location will be Council Chambers in Town Hall; music is in process. 
 
Secretary will work on minister and National Anthem. 
 
Discussion held regarding flags and seats for holders; also for flags handed out and Gold Star banners. 
 
Next meeting is October 19, 2026 at 1900 at Wallingford Town Hall Room 220.  
 
Meeting adjourned at 1931 after a moment of silence for departed members. 
 
 
Respectfully submitted, 
 
 
Elise M. Gallup 
Secretary
